SIGINT COLLECT. AT 311458ZJUL22, [ 1.4a ] HANDED BACK TO THE LRE. AT 311519ZJUL22,
[ 1.4a ] LANDED AT OJMS. FULL MOTION VIDEO WAS EXPLOITED BY DGS1. 20.9 MISSION
HOURS, 17.2 IMINT HOURS, 1 IMINT TASKINGS PROSECUTED, 18.7 SIGINT HOURS, 1 SIGINT

GENTEXT/ISR

• Gentext: (SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY) [1.4a] COORDINATED WITH TF CHOSIN 103 MINUTES PRIOR TO TAKE OFF. COORDINATION WAS SATISFACTORY DUE TO QUALITY OF PRODUCTS. PLEASE SEE ATTACHED 7-LINE FOR MISSION ESSENTIAL ELEMENTS OF INFORMATION (EEIS). AT 2028Z, [1.4a] ARRIVED ON OP SPECTRE DAGGER, FORCE PRO ISO TF CHOSIN AND TF CHOSIN SENSOR TASKING AUTHORITY (STA) DIRECTED [1.4a] TO PROVIDE IMINT IVO 37SFU38[1.4a]81[1.4a]. FROM 2028Z TO 2100Z, [1.4a] SCANNED IVO SP (37SFU38[1.4a]81[1.4a]) FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY. AT 2029Z, [1.4a] OBSERVED 1X ADM SITTING ON TOP OF CARGO TRUCK PARKED BEHIND TREE IVO 37SFU38[1.4a]81[1.4a]. FROM 2100Z TO 2136Z, [1.4a] SCANNED COI 1 AND RUNWAY IVO 37SFU29[1.4a]73[1.4a] FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY, NSTR. FROM 2136Z TO 2210Z, [1.4a] CONDUCTED RUNAWAY SCANS IVO 37SFU29[1.4a]73[1.4a] FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY. AT 2210Z 1X POSS TECHINCAL OBS IVO 37SFU28[1.4a]73[1.4a] FROM 2210Z TO 0037Z, [1.4a] SCANNED IVO COI 1 (37SFU27[1.4a]73[1.4a]) FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY. AT 2252Z, [1.4a] SCANNED IVO 37SFU34[1.4a]76[1.4a] FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY, NSTR. AT 0023Z, [1.4a] OBS 1X ADM ON A MOTO AND CONDUCTED A FOLLOW. FROM 0023Z TO 0030Z, THE ADM MADE 1 STOP IVO 37SFU3[1.4a]80[1.4a]. FROM 0037Z TO 0315Z, [1.4a] SCANNED IVO 37SFU33[1.4a]69[1.4a] 37SFU33[1.4a]69[1.4a], 37SFU33[1.4a]69[1.4a], 37SFU31[1.4a]67[1.4a], 37SFU33[1.4a]94[1.4a], 37SFU27[1.4a]73[1.4a], AND 37SFU34[1.4a]66[1.4a] FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY, NSTR. AT 0245Z, [1.4a] OBSERVED 1X

ADM IVO 37SFU27[1.4a]7[1.4a]. AT 0256Z, [1.4a ]OBSERVED 1X REINFORCED STRUCTURE IVO
37SFU34[1.4a]b6[1.4a] FROM 0315Z TO 0521Z, [1.4a ]SCANNED IVO 37SFU35[1.4a]b7[1.4a]
37SFU28[1.4a]/3[1.4a]. FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY, NSTR. AT 0521Z, [1.4a ]OBSERVED 1X WHITE
PUT, 1X BLACK PUT, AND 2X WHITE BONGOS CARRYING APPROX 30 ADMS, WHICH THEN
[1.4a ]CONDUCTED A FOLLOW. FROM 0521Z TO 0715Z, [1.4a ]FOLLOWED THE VEHICLES
AND OBSERVED 2X STOPS IVO 37SFU28[1.4a] 73[1.4a] 37SFU 28[1.4a]73[1.4a] AT 0523Z, [1.4a ]
OBSERVED 1X PROB TECHNICAL IVO 37SFU28[1.4a]/3[1.4a]. AT 0528Z, THE CONVOY STOPPED N
OF AN OVERHANG AND ALL ADMS EXITED THE VEHICLES, WALKING UNDER THE
OVERHAND. 1X ADM SLUNG A RILE OVER HIS RIGHT SHOULDER. AREA ASSESSED TO BE
A POSS SHOOTING RANGE. AT 0633Z, THE ADMS REENTERED THE VEHICLES CONSISTING
OF 1X WHITE JEEP, 1X BLACK PUT, 2X WHITE BONGOS AND DEPARTED. AT 0648Z, THE
CONVOY STOPPED IVO 37SFU31[1.4a]76[1.4a] APPROX 5X ADMS DISMOUNTED AND THE 1X
WHITE JEEP LEFT THE CONVOY BEFORE THE CONVOY DEPARTED AGAIN. AT 0655Z 1X
WHITE BONGO LEFT THE CONVOY AND FOV IVO 37SFU33[1.4a]/3[1.4a]. AT 0710Z, THE CONVOY
STOPPED IVO 37SFU40[1.4a]70[1.4a] AND THE ADMS DISMOUNTED AND LOITERED AND 1X
TECHNICAL WAS OBSERVED. AT 0715Z THE FOLLOW WAS ENDED AT A COMPOUND IVO
37SFU40[1.4a]70[1.4a]. FROM 0715Z TO 0818Z, [1.4a ]SCANNED AROUND THE COMPOUND IVO
37SFU40[1.4a]70[1.4a] FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY. AT 0721Z, 1X TECHNICAL AND 1X QUAD
CAB PUT WERE OBSERVED. AT 0725Z, 2X ADM DEPARTED THE COMPOUND ON A MOTO.
FROM 0755Z TO 0818Z, [1.4a ]SCANNED COI 1 IVO 37SFU27[1.4a]/3[1.4a]FOR EEI RELATED
ACTIVITY. AT 0753Z, 1X WHITE PUT WITH UI OBJECT, POSS ARTILLERY SYSTEM, IN THE
BED AND 1X ADM WERE OBSERVED. FROM 0818Z TO 0854Z, [1.4a ]PERFORMED A FOLLOW
ON THE PUT WITH THE UI OBJECT IN THE BED, SLANT 2/0/0. AT 0823Z, THE 2X ADMS AND
1X ADDITIONAL ADM ENTERED THE TRUCK AND DEPARTED. SLANT 3/0/0. AT 0832Z, A
SECOND TRUCK WITH POSS MOUNTED AAA WAS OBSERVED IVO 37SFU26[1.4a]/3[1.4a]. FROM
0854Z TO 0942Z [1.4a ]PERFORMED A FOLLOW ON 1X BONGO WITH 2X POSS BARRELS IN
THE BACK FOR 6 STOPS, SLANT 2/0/0. AT 0906Z, THE BONGO STOPPED IVO
37SFU27[1.4a]72[1.4a] WHERE 2X ADDITIONAL ADMS CAME FROM A COMPOUND AND
INTERACTED WITH THE BONGO BEFORE 2X ADM LEFT IN THE BONGO. AT 0911Z, THE
BONGO STOPPED IVO 37SFU27[1.4a]74[1.4a] WHERE A PREVIOUSLY ONOBSERVED ADM
EXITED THE BACK OF THE BONGO AND INTERACTED WITH A PASSENGER BEFORE THE
BONGO DEPARTED. AT 0921Z, THE BONGO STOPPED AT A RESIDENCE IVO
37SFU29[1.4a]76[1.4a]. THE 2X ADMS FROM THE BONGO AND 3X ADMS FROM THE RESIDENCE
INTERACTED WITH THE 2X BARRELS IN THE BACK AND THE BONGO DEPARTED AT 0923Z.
FROM 0942Z TO 1007Z, [1.4a ]TRANSITED TO NEXT POINT. FROM 1007Z TO 1122Z, [1.4a ]
SCANNED IVO COI 2 (37SEV98[1.4a]l 5[1.4a]) FOR EEI RELATED ACTIVITY, NSTR. FROM 1122Z TO
1137Z, [1.4a ]SCANNED IVO DAYR AZ ZAR PARKING AFLD (37SFV07[1.4a]05[1.4a]) FOR EEI
RELATED ACTIVITY. AT 1134Z, 2X TELARS WITH 3 ROCKETS LOADED WERE INACTIVE.
FROM 1137Z TO 1243Z, [1.4a ]SCANNED IVO COI 2 (37SEV98[1.4a]l 5[1.4a]) FOR EEI RELATED
ACTIVITY, NSTR. AT 1243Z, TF CHOSIN STA CLEARED [1.4a ]OFF TASKING AND [1.4a ]
RETURNED TO BASE
